display: FARRUH WORKSPACE PRO · ROSÉ GLASS MINIMAL 1.7.0
details: User approved concept #3 (wine-rose glass minimalism) for the deployed MORE SUSHI Workspace. Replaced the former neon/gold/illustration-heavy theme with a single restrained burgundy and smoked-pink frosted-glass visual system. Soft ambient gradients, translucent project cards, rose-metal edges, readable sans-serif typography, subdued artwork, minimalist status blocks and a calm five-tab dock. Same seven project links, authentications, recipes, TTK, PDF, REVISION, storage, cloud access and update mechanics. Three project columns on tablets, two on narrow phones for readability. Native Android top bar comes from installed APK and cannot be removed by a website update.
